digests.title: TLDR Daily Digest
digests.tagline: AI, IT, Web Dev, InfoSec, DevOps, Design

stories.headline: DeepSeek to Pre-train V5 Model on Huawei Ascend Hardware
stories.blurb: DeepSeek plans to pre-train its next frontier model on Huawei Ascend chips, marking a critical test of whether Chinese AI development can operate independently of Nvidia hardware.

stories.headline: Apple Opens Siri AI Integration to Third-Party Developers
stories.blurb: Apple released Siri AI features in the iOS 27.3 beta, allowing external developers to integrate natural language capabilities and personal context into their apps.

stories.headline: Anthropic Advances Cryptographic Verification for LLM Inference
stories.blurb: Anthropic published research on using zKSNARK cryptographic proofs to verify which AI model produced a given output, enabling stronger auditing and compliance mechanisms.

stories.headline: Stolen LLM Credentials Trigger Daily Costs Up to $100K
stories.blurb: Mandiant reported a sharp rise in attackers stealing cloud service accounts and LLM API keys to run unauthorized high-volume inference workloads at the victims' expense.

stories.headline: OpenAI Scales Version Control with Custom Pando Git Backend
stories.blurb: OpenAI developed Pando, a custom Git backend handling over a petabyte of daily data that cut median push latency by 80% through horizontal scaling.

stories.headline: Databricks Launches Serverless Lakebase Postgres on Google Cloud
stories.blurb: Lakebase Postgres reached general availability as a fully managed, serverless database that unifies operational and analytical storage formats.

stories.headline: Database Latency Analysis Highlights NVMe Storage Advantage
stories.blurb: PlanetScale demonstrated that using local NVMe storage instead of network-attached disk arrays eliminates subtle network hops and significantly reduces costs for write-heavy workloads.

stories.headline: Stockfish Port Proves Software Improvements Outpace Compute Gains
stories.blurb: Running modern Stockfish on a retro 200 MHz Pentium Pro achieved a 3180 ELO rating, demonstrating that modern chess engine leaps stem primarily from search algorithms over raw hardware power.

stories.headline: Red Hat Patches Critical 9.8-Rated Linux Kernel TCP Vulnerability
stories.blurb: Red Hat released emergency patches for CVE-2026-98432, a use-after-free bug in Linux IPv4 TCP handling that could allow attackers to execute arbitrary code remotely.

stories.headline: Tech Coalition Dismantles 1.3M-Device Android TV Botnet
stories.blurb: Security researchers and tech firms disrupted the XCPE botnet after it hijacked more than 1.3 million Android TV boxes for ad fraud and residential proxy traffic.

stories.headline: Suspected Cyberattacks Spoil Food Across European Supermarket Chains
stories.blurb: Remote temperature tampering disabled refrigeration in over 40 European supermarkets, underscoring the operational vulnerabilities of legacy connected devices.

stories.headline: Structuring Design Systems for AI Agent Compatibility
stories.blurb: New analysis emphasizes that making design systems AI-ready requires strict component constraints and active human feedback loops rather than static documentation alone.

stories.headline: Nubank Unveils Global Brand Identity Ahead of US Expansion
stories.blurb: Nubank partnered with agency Koto to deploy a revamped visual identity, custom typography, and dynamic motion design system for its 140 million global users.
